department: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering

deadline.value: Fall-start applications for the MS and PhD are due December 1. The page gives no year, so the 2026/27 cycle is used.
deadline.quote: Master of Science and Ph.D. Applicants

gre_general.value: The department no longer requires the GRE for admissions.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is no longer required by our department for admissions.

gre_subject.value: No GRE, including a subject test, is required.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE is no longer required by our department for admissions.

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: Assistantships are available, but the page gives no share of admitted students who are funded.

entry_route.value: The PhD can be entered with or without a master's, with a 72-credit total from the bachelor's.
entry_route.quote: Entering a Ph.D. program directly from an undergraduate program without a master’s degree typically adds one to two years to the Ph.D. completion timeline

notes: The page lists fees of $60 domestic and $70 international, the same as the Graduate School; the department cannot waive fees. The 2026/27 cycle deadline is December 1 (applications for spring are October 1, not used).
name: Civil and Environmental Engineering (Ph.D.)
